eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 32 · Grouping and Aggregating

code:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalProducts
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Counts every row, NULLs included — "how many rows total."

code:
SELECT COUNT(Color) AS ProductsWithColor
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Only counts rows where THAT column isn't NULL — can be less than COUNT(*).

code:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Color) AS UniqueColors
FROM Production.Product;
caption: 20 red products still count as just ONE distinct color: 'Red'.

subtitle: Two more aggregate functions, same set-based idea.
